reviewer: Primary agent; manual source/control-flow and bound-executable disassembly inspection; no delegated reviews or program execution.

reviews.summary: Both persistent-kernel variants receive the unchanged requested count and recompute complete CSR products on every pass. Grid-stride row coverage and lane-stride nonzero coverage are complete. Compilation retains the arithmetic within the outer repetition backedge in both the scalar and warp paths.

source_evidence.claim: No iteration reduction; the zero-count preparation launch does not replace the timed work.

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed launch forwards the requested count and synchronizes device completion.

Scalar count R0 compares against parameter 0x190 and branches 0x1660 -> 0x80. Warp count R26 compares against the same parameter and branches 0x930 -> 0xc0. Both enclosing loops retain fresh DFMA arithmetic.

reviews.summary: One warp per row repeats a full row product inside the persistent kernel for every requested iteration. The warm-up is a separate one-iteration invocation. The compiled kernel retains nonzero loads, DFMA, warp reduction and the output store inside the repetition loop.

source_evidence.claim: Every row is covered and the timed kernel receives the full CLI count after an additional warm-up.

compiled_evidence.claim: R24 increments and compares against iteration parameter 0x184. The 0x900 -> 0x1b0 backedge encloses CSR DFMA and reduction/store operations, rather than just cached-result stores.

reviews.summary: Both scalar and warp variants retain the full requested work count. The scalar path interchanges rows and repetitions, which is valid for the invariant input vector; it still recomputes every nonzero product. The warp path similarly recomputes its complete row on each device-side repetition.

source_evidence.claim: The full CLI count is passed to the selected persistent kernel; warm-up adds work and no count is clamped or divided.

compiled_evidence.claim: Warp count R6 compares against 0x184 and repeats at 0x1520 -> 0x2f0. Scalar count R4 likewise compares against 0x184 and repeats at 0x17d0 -> 0x370. Both loops enclose DFMA arithmetic, output stores and the corresponding complete CSR path.

reviews.notes: Row/repetition interchange and persistent kernels are work-preserving implementation choices, not omissions. This inspection covers both source-selected variants of the bound sm_86 validation executable.
